headquarters.en: No permanent secretariat (Free Trade Commission; national Secretariat sections in each country)
headquarters.zh: 無常設總部（由自由貿易委員會運作，三國各設秘書處分部）

nature.zh: 三國自由貿易協定（取代北美自由貿易協定 NAFTA）

purpose.en: Keeps trade among the US, Mexico and Canada largely tariff-free, with rules of origin (especially for cars), labour and digital-trade rules.
purpose.zh: 讓美、墨、加三國間的貿易大致免關稅，並訂有原產地規則（特別是汽車）、勞工與數位貿易等規範。

notes: Entered into force 1 July 2020, replacing NAFTA (1994).
2026 joint review (Art. 34.7): at the 1 July 2026 review the US did not confirm a 16-year extension (USTR: did not agree to renew 'in its current form'); Mexico and Canada supported extension.
Consequence: annual joint reviews until all three agree to extend; otherwise the agreement expires 1 July 2036. Tariff preferences and all other provisions remain fully in force meanwhile.
Separate US tariffs imposed on Canada/Mexico in 2025-2026 under other US laws are outside USMCA membership and not reflected here.
